subject.title: fix(browser): check own profile entries for profile operations

question: Should OpenClaw accept a path-specific `constructor` exception in config merge-patch for `browser.profiles` after the TypeScript blocker is fixed?
rationale: The branch intentionally narrows a prototype-pollution guard; automation can repair the test access bug, but it cannot own the permanent security-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the test type error, keep the focused pollution/regression coverage, and let maintainers complete normal security-boundary review before merge.

options.title: Request a different boundary
options.body: Ask for a design that avoids allowing any blocked object key through generic merge-patch, even for browser profile record keys.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the PR paused if maintainers are not comfortable changing the prototype-key guard in this release window.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the test type error, keep the focused pollution/regression coverage, and let maintainers complete normal security-boundary review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current affected checks and merge-patch guard blame to recent work associated with `steipete`, making him the best available owner for the security-boundary choice.
